description: This file defines the LeaveWithDaysLeft data transfer object (DTO) class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It encapsulates information about a leave record, including properties such as id, date, length in hours and days, status, leave type, employee number, and days left. The class provides a constructor and getter/setter methods for each property.

classes.name: LeaveWithDaysLeft
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class representing leave information with additional days left data in the OrangeHRM leave plugin.
